{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[File:Bivoli_crew.jpg|200px|thumb|The crew attempts to stop the theft of their ship.]]
{{Quote|No, those would be the people I stole the ship from!|Slyssk|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 13">[[Knights of the Old Republic 13|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 13]]</ref>}}
The '''original crew of the ''Little Bivoli''''' owned and operated the [[Quartermaster-class supply carrier|''Quartermaster''-class supply carrier]] for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] as a [[Fringer/Legends|fringer]] provisioning [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Whilst they were refueling the ship on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Slyssk]] stole it for [[Marn Hierogryph]] and [[Zayne Carrick]]. The crew arrived at [[Pad 223]], where Slyssk had delivered the ship, shortly afterwards and fired on the thieves with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] in an attempt to stop them. Their efforts were unsuccessful and the ''Little Bivoli'' took off without them.
